import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
sns.barplot(y=top_breeds.index, x=top_breeds.values, palette='viridis', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
age_dist = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
# Filter to reasonable ages (0-20 years)
age_order = [f'{i}-Jährige' for i in range(21)]
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundLang'].isin(age_order)]['AlterVHundNum'].dropna()
ax2.hist(age_data, bins=20, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(labelsize=8)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(district_counts)))
ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# 4. Gender Distribution (Dogs)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df.groupby('SexHundLang')['AnzHunde'].sum()
colors_gender = ['#FF9999', '#66B2FF']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_gender)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Owner Age Groups
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
owner_age = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax5.bar(range(len(owner_age)), owner_age.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(owner_age.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Dogs by Owner Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Yearly trend
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
yearly_trend = df.groupby('StichtagDatJahr')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_index()
ax6.plot(yearly_trend.index, yearly_trend.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='darkgreen')
ax6.fill_between(yearly_trend.index, yearly_trend.values, alpha=0.3, color='lightgreen')
ax6.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Dog Registration Trend Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax6.tick_params(labelsize=8)

plt.suptitle('Comprehensive Analysis of Dog Registration Data in Zurich', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
